europeanStandards.title: WHAT IS MED EXPERT EU?
europeanStandards.point1: Independent medical data audit provided by specialists from Europe.
europeanStandards.point2: Evaluation of provided documentation for compliance with international standards without visas or language barriers.
europeanStandards.point4: Not a clinical appointment, but a strategic informational analysis.

speed.title: WHO CONDUCTS THE AUDIT?
speed.point1: Specialized experts and medical analysts from Europe (Fachärzte).
speed.point2: Specialists with years of experience working according to European standards of evidence-based medicine.
speed.point3: Prompt response — finished analytical report starting from 24 hours.

channels.title: WHAT DO YOU RECEIVE?
channels.point1: Expert Report (PDF): a professional document with conclusions from a specialized European specialist.
channels.point2: Analytical review of the current situation regarding compliance with international protocols.
channels.point3: Clear informational recommendations and justifications based on current global standards.

privacy.title: HOW DOES THE AUDIT WORK?
privacy.point1: You upload your medical data and formulate your request in a secure chat.
privacy.point2: Situation analysis: the expert reviews the documents and asks clarifying questions if necessary.
privacy.point3: Protocol verification: assessment of the case for compliance with current international recommendations (ESMO, ESC, EAU).
privacy.point4: Result: a PDF file with a detailed expert audit.

alternative.title: WHAT TO DO WITH THE EUROPEAN REPORT?
alternative.point1: The received report is a powerful information base for joint discussion with your attending physician.

feedback.title: FEEDBACK:
feedback.point1: You provide the translated PDF report to a local specialist in your city.
feedback.point2: Your attending physician reviews the document and the analysis of European protocols.
feedback.point3: The doctor can adapt the tactics within the framework of your country's legislation.
feedback.point4: We have organized this bridge between experts and local doctors.

profit.title: WHY IS IT BENEFICIAL?
profit.point1: European analytics at an affordable price without travel expenses.
profit.point2: Access to information on 'Gold Standards' of medicine.
profit.point3: In-person consultation in the EU: from €2,000.
profit.point4: Med Expert online audit — 98% savings while accessing the same level of audit.
profit.point5: Expenses in the EU: ~€3,000 (fee + flight), Med Expert: ~€120.

diagnosis.title: FOR MEDICAL DATA ANALYSIS
diagnosis.point1: Do you have medical test results and require an independent assessment?
diagnosis.point2: Our experts will audit your documents for compliance with modern international protocols.

treatment.title: FOR ACCESS TO INTERNATIONAL PROTOCOLS
treatment.point1: Do you want to learn about current trends in world medicine?
treatment.point2: In our report, we provide an analytical summary of alternative methods available in Europe to discuss with your attending physician.

check.title: FOR INFORMATION VERIFICATION (EBM)
check.point1: We conduct a technical review of your medical records and prescriptions for compliance with the principles of Evidence-Based Medicine (EBM).

secondOpinion.title: THE 'SECOND OPINION' PROBLEM:
secondOpinion.point1: When opinions differ, an independent international expert provides an objective analytical report to help the patient and their physician make an informed decision.

trust.title: ACCESSIBILITY OF AUDIT:
trust.point1: Access to European analytics without flights, visas, or language barriers.
trust.point2: The service provides exclusively information and consulting services.

warning.title: Important!
warning.text1: This report is for informational and analytical purposes only ("Second Opinion") and does not constitute a medical service. The service and the expert shall not be held liable for the user's independent use of the data provided.
warning.text2: All analytical materials in this report are strictly intended for discussion with your treating physician. Only an in-person licensed physician is authorized to make clinical decisions, issue official prescriptions, or provide referrals.
warning.emergency: This service is not intended for emergency medical assistance. In the event of a life-threatening situation, dial 112 immediately.
